newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-ROCKETS' BARKLEY, OLAJUWON LEAD WEST ALL-STAR VOTING.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-ROCKETS' BARKLEY, OLAJUWON LEAD WEST ALL-STAR VOTING.

text.p: Forward Charles Barkley and centre Hakeem Olajuwon of the Houston Rockets are the top vote-getters at their respective positions in the latest Western Conference All-Star balloting released on Tuesday.

Barkley moved past Seattle's Shawn Kemp to lead all forwards with 304,085 fan votes for the 46th NBA All-Star Game, to be played at Gund Arena in Cleveland on February 9. Kemp is second with 296,090 votes.
Olajuwon, an 11-time All-Star, continues to lead all centres in the Western Conference with 295,043 votes. Shaquille O'Neal of the Los Angeles Lakers is second among centres with 242,447 votes.
Utah Jazz guard John Stockton, the NBA's all-time leader in assists and steals, jumped into second place among guards behind Seattle's Gary Payton, who leads with 218,941.
Stockton, who has played in eight All-Star games but started only twice in 1989 and 1993, has 192,144 votes to lead injured Phoenix Suns guard Jason Kidd (140,865).
Karl Malone of Utah is third among forwards (202,189) followed by Minnesota's Kevin Garnett (98,428) and Tom Gugliotta (83,445).

All-Star starters will be announced Sunday, January 26. All NBA head coaches will vote for the remaining members of the All-Star teams in their respective conferences and their selections will be announced January 28 or 29.
